title: Fezandipiti (Poke Ball) - Prismatic Evolutions - 045/131 - Pokemon TCG - Rare
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The Fezandipiti card from the Prismatic Evolutions set in the Pokémon TCG is a rare psychic-type Pokémon card with HP 120. Illustrated by Kouki Saitou, this basic stage card features a foil finish, making it a desirable addition for collectors and players alike. Manufactured by Nintendo in 2024, this English-language card is sure to appeal to fans of the game looking to enhance their collection with a unique and powerful Pokémon.
